messages.subject: Stan SEO down under
parts:
Good news: We're ahead of Eminem here.

Bad news: We're so far behind the streaming
media service called Stan (the Ozzie Netflix), that
we're hit #11 --- not even on the first page.

I wouldn't wish ill on a company I know nothing about,
but if they happened to disappear, we'd be the number one
hit.

We could always mirror mc-stan.org in every country
with a significant (pun intended) number of statisticians.
Google really likes to feed you results from the domains
related to the country you're searching from (.au here).

- Bob

P.S. Same results on Safari on my notebook and Safari on
my phone (with brand new Ozzie sim card).
